surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transitions between the base skin tone and mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent longitudinal dorsal ridge along the central axis, creating a distinct light-shadow transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of faint linear epidermal scratches on the left lateral side.
